note: Axis 3 executable-depth measurement for Mento Labs USDm on Celo. Celo and Monad are separate, non-fungible exit markets while NTT is not operational; no cross-chain liquidity is pooled.

identity.identity_note: This is the former cUSD contract renamed in place to USDm, not Mountain Protocol USDM or Monetrix USDM.

depth.slippage_convention: The published 2% ladder uses marginal impact: total USD execution return at each rung is debiased by the smallest successful $100 rung. Total return versus the dated dashboard USDm/USD mark is retained separately; that Mento-derived mark is used for input sizing and is not claimed as an independent market cross-check.
depth.basis: No 2% crossing was located. The Celo Mento V3 USDm/USDC FPMM remained oracle-priced and inside the threshold through 500,000 USDm, worth $500,430 at the dated $1.00086 USDm market mark. This is published as a floor, not located depth. The floor stops at the on-chain short-window maxIn limit returned for USDm; quotes above that limit are not treated as executable depth even though the view quoter returns them.

binding_constraint.note: Limits are stateful and must be re-read before execution; this payload records the values observed at the measurement block.

anchor.independence_note: The mark is Mento-derived and is not an independent market cross-check. The 2% result uses smallest-rung marginal impact, so this mark sizes USD notionals but does not set the impact baseline.

quote.method: Mento SDK Router.getAmountsOut over the direct Celo Mento V3 FPMM route

primary_exit.gated_basis: public router route; circuit breaker enabled and current trading limits have capacity
primary_exit.note: This venue is constrained by stateful trading limits. It should not be interpreted as conventional reserve-bounded secondary-market depth.

enumeration.source: Mento SDK canonical Celo route cache plus live Router and trading-limit reads
enumeration.chain_scope_note: Monad USDm liquidity is excluded because NTT is not operational and the markets cannot be combined into an executable exit.

venues.name: Mento V3 USDm/USDC
venues.depth_role: Canonical Celo exit route measured above; pool balance/TVL is not substituted for depth.

separate_market_observation.observation: The existing Monad USDm/USDC getAmountOut ladder is flat at -3.9 bps through its largest $100,000 quote, but this is not pooled with or substituted for Celo depth.
